name: SAVE THE FROGS! Amphibian Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for amphibian conservation projects covering research, education, policy or habitat. Individuals can apply within the USA; elsewhere only nonprofits or educational organisations. Applicants must be members of the funder.

amount.note: Larger requests only with prior approval

reporting: A progress report within six months of receiving funds if the final report is not yet in, and a final report by the date stated in the application and no later than one year after funds arrive.

calls.label: Application window (1 June to 1 July)
calls.recurring: Applications accepted from June 1 and due July 1 at 11:59pm Los Angeles time, once per year

status.quote: Grant applications are accepted once per year.

recurring.quote: Grant applications will be accepted beginning June 1st. Grant applications must be submitted by July 1st at 11:59pm Los Angeles time.

applicant_types.quote: Grants may be given to individuals or organizations within the USA. Outside the USA, grants will only be given to nonprofit organizations (e.g. NGO) or official educational organizations (e.g. school or university).

geography.quote: Outside the USA, grants will only be given to nonprofit organizations (e.g. NGO)

window.quote: Grant applications are accepted once per year.

amount.quote: The maximum allowable request is $2,000 unless you have contacted us in advance and received approval to request more.

reporting.quote: Successful applicant must submit a progress report within six months of funds receipt if they have not yet submitted the final report.
